title: NVIDIA container initialization inherited untrusted execution context

cwe_mappings.note: Explicit classification in the vendor security advisory.

summary: ZDI awarded Wiz researchers USD 30,000 for this single Pwn2Own Berlin 2025 entry.
root_cause: A privileged container-initialization component inherited container-controlled execution context without sufficient separation from host authority.
impact: An untrusted container image could lead to code execution with elevated host permissions. Scope depends on runtime configuration; NVIDIA explicitly excludes systems using crun from this CVE.
defensive_takeaways: Keep privileged runtime initialization independent of workload-controlled configuration.
Use layered tenant isolation and verify vendor-specific runtime applicability before remediation.

reward.awarding_organization: Trend Micro Zero Day Initiative / Pwn2Own Berlin
reward.evidence_location: Named Wiz researchers’ entry in the organizer’s dated daily results
reward.notes: One competition-entry award, not the researchers’ event total. Official rules specify US currency; recipient allocation and actual cash settlement are unverified.

published.note: Primary research article publication; earlier competition results are separately dated.

public_disclosure.note: Public demonstration and result; vendor technical advisory followed later.

reported.note: The researchers explicitly date this CVE’s initial vendor report at Pwn2Own to May 17. ZDI separately lists June 5 as its vendor-notification date; that later coordination event is not substituted for the initial report.

awarded.note: Award announced for the named individual entry.

fixed.note: Vendor bulletin initially released July 15, 2025 and later revised affected products and fixes; the exact release date for each patched component was not established.
